colors.description: Warm bone-white background for tactile paper feel, deep forest green for primary typography and architecture, with terracotta (maple) accents for interactions.

typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Cabinet Grotesk for bold kinetic reveals. Cormorant Garamond for elegant italicized quotes and manifesto chapter numbers.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #1A3626 with 15% opacity for structural grids (Bento layouts).
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-none for all cards, images, and buttons to enforce a strict editorial, architectural aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.shadows: No soft shadows. Rely on sharp borders and negative space.
visual_enhancers.image_treatment: Deliberate photography. Use spotlight effects or clipped/masked frames. Max height 80vh on mobile.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a very subtle noise overlay globally to mimic organic paper.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections. gap-8 to gap-16 in grids.
layouts.grids: Asymmetrical Bento Grid (e.g., col-span-8 and col-span-4 combinations).
layouts.navigation: Sticky, glassmorphic header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F7F5F0]/70) with 1px bottom border.
layouts.footer: Massive typography (text-[10vw]) for the brand name, dark background (#1A3626) with light text (#F7F5F0).

motion.hero_kinetic: Signature on-load moment: Masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion (overflow-hidden wrapper, text slides up from y: 100%).
motion.scrolling: Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling globally on marketing pages.
motion.scroll_reveals: Use framer-motion 'whileInView' for subtle section reveals (y: 40, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.8, ease: cubic-bezier).
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on hero images using framer-motion useScroll and useTransform hooks.
motion.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for partner names or manifesto keywords using react-fast-marquee. Massive outline text or refined serif ribbons.

component_instructions.forms: Shadcn UI forms. Override default rounding to rounded-none. Inputs must have 1px solid border, clear focus states (ring-0 border-[#1A3626]).
component_instructions.buttons: Sharp rectangular buttons (rounded-none). Dark background, light text. On hover, background shifts to terracotta (#C65D47).
component_instructions.dashboard: Strict grid hierarchy. High density. Sidebar navigation. Avoid card components; use flat layouts with sharp separators. Do not use Lenis scrolling in the admin dashboard.

key_features_to_build: Large kinetic hero with masked text reveal
Numbered manifesto chapters (using Cormorant Garamond for the oversized numerals)
Forms for Pledge/Donation, Membership, Program Apps, Volunteer, Contact
Admin Dashboard to view form submissions

libraries.install_commands: yarn add framer-motion @studio-freight/react-lenis react-fast-marquee lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or uniform styling. Prioritize asymmetry.
Do not use transition: all. Target specific properties (e.g. transition-colors, transition-transform).
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
All interactive elements and inputs MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-button').
Ensure contrast ratios meet APCA/WCAG AA standards, especially on form placeholders and muted text.
Use Shadcn UI components for forms, dialogs, and admin tables, but override their aesthetic to match the sharp editorial style.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays with content underneath.
